## Journeys

| # | Journey | Crosses | Status | Tests | Gaps |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Public visitor becomes verified applicant | public, admissions, identity | designed | — | No admissions capability or applicant verification flow exists. |
| 2 | Applicant becomes student without duplicate identity | admissions, identity, institution, student | designed | — | Applicant-to-student identity linking is a design document, not a tested workflow. |
| 3 | Student signs in through institution SSO | identity, institution, student | designed | — | SSO policy is proved in SQL; no browser journey exercises a real identity provider. |
| 4 | Student uploads a course packet and receives source-linked outputs | student, learning, ai_governance | designed | — | Persistence and derivation receipts are proved in SQL; no end-to-end upload journey runs in CI. |
| 5 | Student corrects an extracted date; calendar and study assets regenerate | student, learning | designed | — | Correction bindings exist in SQL; regeneration of calendar and study assets is not an end-to-end test. |
| 6 | Student asks a grounded question and sees citations and AI disclosure | learning, ai_governance | designed | — | Policy and audit are proved in SQL; the citation and disclosure rendering has no browser journey. |
| 7 | Student checks registration readiness and receives a non-enrollment receipt | student, registrar | designed | — | No HTTP route or worker calls the readiness store yet (capabilities/registration.readiness.json api stage is false). |
| 8 | Registrar sees only authorized case data, reviews blocker, and routes it | registrar, institution, operations | designed | — | The registrar readiness case screen is a contract (screen_contracts) without an implementation. |
| 9 | Faculty grades a submission; draft cannot appear as official grade | faculty, registrar | designed | — | Draft and official stores are separate in SQL; no journey proves the boundary across the gradebook screen. |
| 10 | Official grade reference syncs and displays source and freshness | institution, registrar, student | designed | — | No SIS adapter is connected; grade freshness display has no live source. |
| 11 | Advisor creates a referral under appropriate consent and scope | advising, student, support | designed | — | Referral SQL is proved; no advising screen or browser journey exists. |
| 12 | Student grants, narrows, and revokes family access | student, family, identity | designed | — | Grant and revoke are proved in SQL; narrowing a live delegation is not an end-to-end test. |
| 13 | Student initiates payment; signed provider webhook reconciles exactly once | student, finance | designed | — | The payment inbox is exactly-once in SQL; no student payment intent reaches a provider (D13). |
| 14 | Employer posts opportunity; student applies with explicit record-sharing consent | career, student, identity | designed | — | No employer portal exists. |
| 15 | Community member reports a post; moderator resolves and appeal works | community, security | designed | — | Moderation audit is proved in SQL; the appeal path has no test. |
| 16 | Marketplace listing creates offer, payment state, dispute, and refund workflow | marketplace, finance, community, security | designed | — | Offers, disputes and refunds have no code (D35 not started). |
| 17 | Institution admin creates grant; revocation blocks session, API, and queued job | institution, identity, security, operations | designed | — | Grant revocation is proved in SQL and the queue refuses a wrong-tenant event; a single journey across session, API and worker does not exist. |
| 18 | Developer creates sandbox app, key, webhook, and handles a signed delivery | developer, security, operations | designed | — | No developer app registration model exists. |
| 19 | Company implementation team activates a new tenant and completes integration checklist | customer, institution, company, operations | designed | — | Tenant rollout state is proved in SQL; the implementation checklist is a document. |
| 20 | Operations operator resolves an incident and produces postmortem evidence | operations | designed | — | Incident rows are proved in SQL; postmortem evidence capture is a runbook step, not a tested command. |
| 21 | Privacy officer processes an export or deletion request | security, institution, student | designed | — | Export and deletion are proved in SQL and the account-sync CI job deletes a real account; the privacy-officer workflow has no screen. |
| 22 | Release rollback restores prior application version without data corruption | operations | designed | — | Rollback is a documented procedure; no drill artifact is produced automatically. |
| 23 | Backup restore produces a usable isolated recovery environment | operations, security | designed | — | The restore drill script exists; no scheduled run writes a drill artifact into a release pack. |
| 24 | Cross-tenant read/write attempt fails through UI, API, SQL/RLS, worker, search, and AI retrieval | security, identity, institution, ai_governance | designed | — | SQL/RLS, the policy engine and the queue are guarded; UI, search and AI retrieval have no cross-tenant test. |
